rajbagh.name: Rajbagh
rajbagh.about:
Rajbagh is a residential locality in the Civil Lines part of Srinagar, set along the Jhelum. Ram Munshi Bagh, Shivpora, Guzarwaan Mohalla and Jawahar Nagar are its neighbours, and Lal Chowk, the main business district, is not far away. Residents often name a smaller part of the locality rather than Rajbagh as a whole: Pathan Bagh, Kursoo Rajbagh, Rajbagh Extension and Aramwari are all used as addresses, so it helps to give the exact part and a nearby landmark when you book a tutor.

Hotels, restaurants and a number of schools sit among the homes, which makes the main roads busy around school opening and closing times. Afternoon and early evening slots after that rush tend to work well for home visits. Because the locality is central, tutors living in Jawahar Nagar, Sonwar or the Lal Chowk side can usually cover it. In the long winter break and the short days of December and January, many families shift sessions earlier in the day or move some classes online. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

jawahar-nagar.name: Jawahar Nagar
jawahar-nagar.about:
Jawahar Nagar lies on the banks of the Jhelum in the Civil Lines area and is one of two planned residential areas laid out by the government in Srinagar, the other being Karan Nagar. Its layout is easy to read for a visiting tutor: wide roads, several parks, houses built on equal-sized plots and a block of government quarters. Gogji Bagh, Wazir Bagh, Rajbagh and Lal Chowk border it.

Since most homes are houses on their own plots, a tutor normally arrives straight at the door and parking is usually found on the street outside. The Gogji Bagh ramp of the Jehangir Chowk–Rambagh flyover sits close by, which helps tutors coming in from the Rambagh, Natipora or airport side. For a student taking JKBOSE board classes, a regular weekday slot at home works well, while specialist subjects or entrance-test preparation can be added online. During the winter break, morning or early afternoon sessions suit the shorter days. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

lal-chowk.name: Lal Chowk
lal-chowk.about:
Lal Chowk is Srinagar's central business district rather than a quiet residential pocket. Since the early twentieth century it has been the city's main shopping and commercial area, stretching along both sides of Residency Road up to the Amira Kadal bridge over the Jhelum. The square itself is a roundabout at the eastern end, marked by a clock tower, the ghanta ghar, put up in 1980. Families live in the lanes and older houses behind the shopfronts and in the residential areas that adjoin it, such as Jawahar Nagar and Rajbagh.

For tuition, the centre's busy daytime traffic is the main thing to plan around. Late afternoon and evening sessions after shops and offices thin out are easier for a tutor to reach, and a clear lane name or landmark saves time. Because Lal Chowk is the centre of the city, tutors from almost any part of Srinagar can get here, and online classes are a simple option for advanced or specialist subjects. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

sonwar.name: Sonwar
sonwar.about:
Sonwar, often called Sonwar Bagh, is a residential area that runs parallel to the Jhelum and the main road near Sonwar Bazaar, below the Takht-i-Sulaiman hill. It is made up of several smaller parts, and families usually give one of these as their address: Iqbal Colony, Indira Nagar, Hamza Colony, Old Sonwar Mohalla, Palpora, Banumsora and the Gupkar Road side. Indira Nagar was once part of a lake, and only a small stretch of water now remains.

The area has become more commercial over time, with schools, hotels, restaurants and a cinema at Shivpora, so the main road can be crowded at school times and in the evening. Homes in the inner colonies are generally quieter and easy to reach on foot from the main road. Tutors from Rajbagh, Shivpora and the Lal Chowk side often take students here. In the cold months, when daylight is short, families commonly prefer earlier slots or a mix of home and online classes. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

karan-nagar.name: Karan Nagar
karan-nagar.about:
Karan Nagar is one of Srinagar's older planned residential areas, close to Lal Chowk on the west side of the centre. A part of it called Deewan Bagh was the first civil colony declared by the princely state government, in 1942, and along with Jawahar Nagar it is one of the two government-planned residential zones in the city. It has Aali Kadal to the south, Batamaloo to the west, Safa Kadal to the north and Nawabazar to the east.

A large institutional campus shares the area with homes, so Karan Nagar is busier than a purely residential colony, especially during the day. Tutors coming for after-school sessions should allow for that traffic and use the lane name or a landmark to find the house. Students here can draw on tutors from Batamaloo, Bemina and the city centre, and online sessions work well for specialist subjects or the long winter break. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

batamaloo.name: Batamaloo
batamaloo.about:
Batamaloo is an old locality west of Lal Chowk, its name said to come from the Kashmiri Batmoul. For many years it was known for the city's main bus stop, where buses from every district halted, until that stand moved to Qamarwari. Shops, workshops and markets still line the main roads, while family homes sit in the lanes around them. It borders Karan Nagar on its eastern side and is a neighbour of Bemina, including the New Colony Batamaloo side.

The market roads are busiest in the morning and early evening. On ordinary weekdays, sessions after the morning market rush and before the evening return traffic are easiest. Tutors from Karan Nagar, Bemina and the city centre can reach Batamaloo readily, and online classes are an easy add-on for board revision during the winter break. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

bemina.name: Bemina
bemina.about:
Bemina, called Bemyun in Kashmiri and recorded in older sources as Abhimanyupur, is a large residential area in western Srinagar. It is one of the planned colonies on the bypass, and today it is made up of several colonies that families use as their address, among them Alamdar Housing Colony, Boatman Colony, MIG Colony, Nundreshi Colony and Sir Syed Abad. Batamaloo, Chattabal, Tengpora and Mominabad are nearby.

Homes are mostly houses in planned colony lanes, so a tutor comes straight to the door and there is usually space to park. Bemina sits on the city bypass, the four-lane corridor that also runs past Tengpora, Hyderpora and Sanat Nagar, which makes it simple for tutors from those areas to reach. That bypass gets heavy at peak hours, so mid-afternoon or later evening slots are easier. For JKBOSE board students and those aiming at national entrance tests, a home tutor for core subjects can be combined with online help for the rest. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

hyderpora.name: Hyderpora
hyderpora.about:
Hyderpora lies on the south-western side of Srinagar, towards the airport road, and has grown from a village on the city's edge into a busy suburb. Sanat Nagar, Barzulla and Rambagh are close by, with Peerbagh, Rawalpora Colony, Shah Anwar Colony, Parray Pora and Jeelanabad Colony among its immediate neighbours. Homes are mainly independent houses and residential plots, and the area is also known locally for its many coaching centres.

The city bypass passes through Hyderpora on its way between Pantha Chowk, Sanat Nagar, Tengpora and Bemina, and this stretch is heavy with traffic at office and school times. A tutor coming from across the city will find mid-afternoon or later evening slots easier, while one living in Peerbagh, Rawalpora or Sanat Nagar can reach a house here quickly. Families who already use local coaching often add a one-to-one tutor for weak topics, or an online tutor for specialist subjects through the long winter break. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

peerbagh.name: Peerbagh
peerbagh.about:
Peerbagh is a residential locality on the airport side of south-western Srinagar, next to Hyderpora and on the way towards Humhama. Its neighbouring colonies include Peerbagh Cooperative Colony, Alfazal Colony, Ibrahim Colony, Rawalpora Colony and Sir Syed Avenue, and residents commonly give one of these colony names as their address. The cooperative colony was laid out as a planned housing colony, and homes across the area are largely houses in residential lanes.

Since the airport lies just beyond the city in Budgam district, the main road through this side carries steady through traffic, so tutors usually prefer to reach the inner colonies through the side lanes and to avoid the morning and early evening rush. Tutors living in Hyderpora, Rawalpora and Sanat Nagar can cover Peerbagh easily. In winter, when the days are short and schools are on their long break, an earlier afternoon slot or a few online sessions keeps a routine going. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

sanat-nagar.name: Sanat Nagar
sanat-nagar.about:
Sanat Nagar is a residential locality in south-western Srinagar with its own post office that also serves nearby colonies such as Rawalpora. Around it are Rawalpora Colony, Chanapora, Parray Pora, Ibrahim Colony and Baghat, and Hyderpora is close by. The area is built up mainly with family houses in colony lanes, along with shops and showrooms on the main road.

Sanat Nagar sits on the city bypass, the four-lane road that links Pantha Chowk with Hyderpora, Tengpora and Bemina. That makes it one of the easier south-side localities for a tutor to reach from different directions, though the bypass is busy at peak hours, so slots outside the school-run and office rush are kinder on travel. Tutors living in Rawalpora, Chanapora or Hyderpora can usually reach a home here quickly. For board classes, regular home visits through the term can be backed up with online revision when the winter break begins. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

rawalpora.name: Rawalpora
rawalpora.about:
Rawalpora, also known as Rawalpora Colony, is a residential area on the south side of Srinagar, served by the Sanat Nagar post office. Its neighbours include Ibrahim Colony, Mini Colony, Parray Pora, Hyderpora and Chanapora, and Peerbagh is close by. Homes are mostly houses within colony lanes, which keeps visits simple: a tutor reaches the door directly without any gate formalities.

On its southern side, a small bridge next to the railway bridge over the Doodhganga gives commuters a shortcut between Bagh-e-Mehtab and Rawalpora, which is handy for tutors travelling from the Nowgam side. Tutors from Sanat Nagar and Hyderpora can also reach it easily. The main roads leading to the bypass are busy at peak hours, so families usually fix sessions for mid-afternoon or after the evening rush. In the long winter break, many students keep up with a mix of home and online classes. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

natipora.name: Natipora
natipora.about:
Natipora is a residential locality on the southern side of Srinagar, between the city centre and Nowgam. Baghat, Mini Colony, Mehjoor Nagar, Nowgam and Lal Nagar are its neighbours, and the area falls under the Nowgam post office. Most homes are family houses in residential lanes off the main road, with local shops and schools among them.

The Jehangir Chowk–Rambagh flyover has a ramp at Natipora, which opened in 2018 as part of the first phase. This gives a quick link to the city centre over the ground-level roads, which is useful for tutors coming from Lal Chowk or Jawahar Nagar. The roads below remain busy at office and school times, so evening sessions after the rush are popular. Tutors living in Barzulla, Nowgam or Sanat Nagar can also reach Natipora readily. In winter, earlier slots suit the shorter days. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

barzulla.name: Barzulla
barzulla.about:
Barzulla is a locality on the southern side of Srinagar, close to Rambagh, Natipora and Hyderpora. It forms the southern end of the Jehangir Chowk–Rambagh flyover, which has its Barzulla ramp near the weather station and links the area with Rambagh, Gogji Bagh and the city centre. Homes are mainly houses in the lanes on either side of the main road, with shops and offices along the road itself.

For a tutor, the flyover is the quick way in from the Lal Chowk side, and the side lanes lead to most homes. The main road is busy through the day, so after-school and early evening slots should be planned with a little extra time. Tutors living in Rambagh, Natipora or Hyderpora can reach Barzulla easily. Students preparing for JKBOSE exams or national entrance tests can mix home tuition with online sessions, especially during the long winter break. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

nowgam.name: Nowgam
nowgam.about:
Nowgam is a locality on the southern edge of Srinagar and is where Srinagar railway station stands. The station, opened in 2008, is on the Jammu–Baramulla line between Pampore and Budgam, and through trains from Jammu began running on the line in June 2025. Around it are residential colonies, with Natipora to the north and Bagh-e-Mehtab and Chanapora towards the south-west. Nowgam also has its own post office, which serves Natipora.

Homes are mainly houses in colony lanes, so a tutor goes straight to the door. A tutor travelling from the Budgam or Pampore side can use the train to Srinagar station and take a short auto or shared ride onward; from the city centre the roads through Natipora are the usual route. Evening slots after the office rush are easier, and in winter the shorter days make earlier sessions or online classes practical. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

bagh-e-mehtab.name: Bagh-e-Mehtab
bagh-e-mehtab.about:
Bagh-e-Mehtab is a residential suburb on the southern side of Srinagar, on the banks of the Doodhganga. The land was once an orchard of plum and apple trees before it was built up. Today the area is mainly residential, with a government housing colony and several private colonies. Its neighbours include Nowgam, Chanapora, Rawalpora, Astanpora, Machowa, Dooniwari, Shankarpora and Gopalpora, and it lies along the road that leads towards Chadoora.

The railway line passes over a bridge on the edge of the area, and a small bridge next to it gives commuters a shortcut to Rawalpora and Gulzarpora, so tutors from that side can reach homes here without the long way round. Houses in the colonies mean doorstep arrival and easy parking. A public library opened in the area in 2021, which some students use for self-study alongside their tuition. In the cold months, families often move to earlier sessions or online classes. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

soura.name: Soura
soura.about:
Soura is an old settlement in northern Srinagar, lying east of Anchar Lake near the southern end of the 90 Feet Road. Buchpora is to its north, Nowshera to its south and Awanta Bhawan towards the east, and the Sabzi Mandi market is part of the area. A large institutional campus sits in the area, so a good deal of institutional land lies alongside the homes.

Families live in the older lanes and the newer residential colonies spreading north and west. The roads near the institutional campus are busy throughout the day, so tutors usually reach homes through the inner lanes and prefer late afternoon or evening slots. Tutors from Buchpora, Nowshera and Lal Bazar can cover Soura easily. Students preparing for NEET often combine a home tutor for physics or chemistry with online classes, especially during the long winter break. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

buchpora.name: Buchpora
buchpora.about:
Buchpora is on the northern edge of Srinagar, on the eastern side of Anchar Lake along the road towards Leh. Once farmland, it has turned into a spread of residential colonies, many of them built for families who moved from the older downtown areas when roads there were widened and they were given plots here. Soura, Hajibagh Colony, Firdous Colony, Illahi Bagh, Rangpora and Umerhair are its neighbours.

Because most homes are houses in newer colony lanes, a tutor reaches the door directly and parking is rarely a concern. The area also links the city to Ganderbal by two main roads, so through traffic builds up at peak hours; tutors coming from the city centre generally choose afternoon slots. There are many local private schools in and around Buchpora, so tuition demand for school classes is steady, and online help works well for specialist subjects or exam revision in winter. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

lal-bazar.name: Lal Bazar
lal-bazar.about:
Lal Bazar is a well-known residential area in the upper downtown part of northern Srinagar, run by the Srinagar Municipal Corporation. It is made up of several neighbourhoods that families give as their address, including Umar Colony, Mughal Street, Broadway Street, Rose Lane, Sikh Bagh and Bagwanpora. Zadibal lies to the west, Awanta Bhawan to the north-west, and the university and engineering campuses around Hazratbal are close by.

With banks, shops and many private schools on its main roads, Lal Bazar is lively at school times, so tuition is easiest once students are home in the afternoon. Homes in the named streets and colonies are mostly houses, which makes doorstep arrival straightforward. Tutors from Zadibal, Soura and the Hazratbal side often teach here, and older students preparing for engineering or medical entrance tests may add an online subject specialist. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

zadibal.name: Zadibal
zadibal.about:
Zadibal is an old residential locality in the northern part of Srinagar, on the eastern banks of Khushal Sar lake. Nowshera is to its north, Hawal and Nowhatta to its south, and Lal Bazar and Badamwari to its east. The area grew up near historic routes and water bodies, and its families were long known for shawl weaving, papier-mâché work, trade and traditional medicine. The Imambara Zadibal, dating from 1518, is one of its oldest and most important historic buildings.

Much of Zadibal is made up of older houses in close lanes, where cars may not reach every door, so tutors often park on the main road and walk the last part. Late afternoon and evening sessions suit most families once school is over. Tutors from Lal Bazar, Nowshera and Soura can cover Zadibal easily, and online classes help in the coldest weeks of the winter break. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

nowshera.name: Nowshera
nowshera.about:
Nowshera is a historic part of northern Srinagar whose Persian name means new city. It was laid out in the fifteenth century, with stone-paved roads and a canal, the Nallah Mar, linking Dal Lake with Anchar Lake. Today it is bounded by Soura and Awanta Bhawan to the north, Zadibal to the south, Lal Bazar to the east and Zunimar to the west. Kagazgari Mohalla keeps alive the memory of the area's old papermaking craft.

Housing is a mix of traditional houses in the old lanes, reflecting the older character of the city, and newer homes on the wider roads. In the old lanes, tutors usually walk the final stretch after parking on the main road. Sessions after school hours work well, and tutors from Zadibal, Soura and Lal Bazar can reach Nowshera without difficulty. During the long winter break, many families use online classes for revision on the coldest days. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

hazratbal.name: Hazratbal
hazratbal.about:
Hazratbal is on the north-western shore of Dal Lake in northern Srinagar. It is a higher education centre, with a university and engineering campuses nearby, so a large share of its land is institutional. The wider area includes residential neighbourhoods such as Naseem Bagh, Mallabagh, Usmaan Abad, Batpora, Zakura, Ishber, Habak, Sadiribal, Gulab Bagh, Bota Kadal and Tailbal, and families usually name one of these as their address.

Homes are mostly houses in these neighbourhoods, so tutors arrive at the door. The lakefront roads can be busy at times, which is worth keeping in mind when fixing a first demo. Because many university students and teachers live in the area, families often find subject tutors close by for senior classes, and online sessions help for entrance-test preparation. In winter, earlier afternoon slots suit the shorter days. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

Civil Lines.fact: Lal Chowk has been Srinagar's main business and shopping hub since the early twentieth century; the precinct stretches along both sides of Residency Road up to the Amira Kadal bridge.
The Lal Chowk roundabout is marked by a clock tower (ghanta ghar) built in 1980.
Jawahar Nagar, on the banks of the Jhelum, is one of two government-planned residential zones in Srinagar (with Karan Nagar), with wide roads, parks and houses on equal-sized plots.
Rajbagh lies in the Civil Lines area along the Jhelum; its parts include Pathan Bagh, Kursoo Rajbagh, Rajbagh Extension and Aramwari.
Sonwar Bagh runs parallel to the Jhelum below the Takht-i-Sulaiman hill and includes Iqbal Colony, Indira Nagar, Hamza Colony, Old Sonwar Mohalla, Palpora and Banumsora.
Indira Nagar was once a lake; only a small stretch of water remains.

Karan Nagar & Bemina.fact: Deewan Bagh in Karan Nagar was the first civil colony declared by the princely state government, in 1942.
Karan Nagar is bounded by Aali Kadal to the south, Batamaloo to the west, Safa Kadal to the north and Nawabazar to the east.
Batamaloo was long known for the city's main bus stop, which later moved to Qamarwari.
Bemina, originally called Abhimanyupur, is now a group of planned colonies on the bypass.
Srinagar's four-lane bypass passes through Pantha Chowk, Sanat Nagar, Hyderpora, Tengpora, HMT, Bemina, Shalteng and Lawaypora.

Airport Road.fact: Srinagar's airport lies in Budgam district, south of the city.
The city bypass runs through Sanat Nagar and Hyderpora on its way between Pantha Chowk and Bemina.
Hyderpora is close to Sanat Nagar, Barzulla and Rambagh; homes are mainly independent houses and residential plots.
Sanat Nagar's neighbours include Rawalpora Colony, Chanapora, Parray Pora, Ibrahim Colony and Baghat.
A small bridge beside the railway bridge over the Doodhganga gives commuters a shortcut between Bagh-e-Mehtab and Rawalpora.

Natipora & Nowgam.fact: Srinagar railway station (code SINA) is in Nowgam, on the Jammu–Baramulla line between Pampore and Budgam; it opened in 2008.
Through train services over the full Jammu–Baramulla line were flagged off on 6 June 2025.
The Natipora ramp of the Jehangir Chowk–Rambagh flyover opened in September 2018 as part of Phase I.
Phase II of the flyover, from Rambagh to Alochi Bagh, opened on 22 May 2019.
The flyover has ramps at Jehangir Chowk, Gogji Bagh, Alochi Bagh, Rambagh, Natipora and Barzulla.
Bagh-e-Mehtab, on the Doodhganga, is mainly residential, with a government housing colony and several private colonies; it was once an orchard.

North City.fact: Soura lies east of Anchar Lake near the southern end of the 90 Feet Road, with Buchpora to the north and Nowshera to the south.
Nowshera ('new city' in Persian) was laid out in the fifteenth century; the Nallah Mar canal linked Dal Lake with Anchar Lake.
Zadibal lies on the eastern banks of Khushal Sar lake; the Imambara Zadibal dates from 1518.
Lal Bazar includes Umar Colony, Mughal Street, Broadway Street, Rose Lane, Sikh Bagh and Bagwanpora.
Buchpora, on the eastern side of Anchar Lake along the Srinagar–Leh road, changed from farmland into residential colonies.
The 90 Feet Road runs along the outer edge of Awanta Bhawan, between Soura and Lal Bazar.
The Hazratbal area includes Naseem Bagh, Mallabagh, Zakura, Batpora, Ishber, Habak and Tailbal.
